obfuscation_indicators: high degree of judgment and complexity
risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantitative and explains major credit charges, loan sales, write-downs, nonperforming assets, and FDIC loss-share mechanics with reasonable specificity. Risk remains elevated because of a substantial net loss, sharply higher loan-loss provisions, distressed loan dispositions, and reliance on judgmental fair-value and cash-flow estimates, although deposit trends and funding costs improved.
